title: E-GRV-0060: a reversible occupancy-gated take exists on the adopted knit, but only as a counter-gated mirror, and it...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0060 in the gravity arena: a reversible occupancy-gated take exists on the adopted knit, but only as a counter-gated mirror, and it keeps no crowd, fail on R5 alone: one integer counter per dock (counting to L(E) = 1 + max(0, E - 32), E the dock energy after its take) gates the take, a slot beside a paused dock turns back into its own opposite slot, and the rule is a bijection with its inverse built (840 of 840 beats inverted exactly over 21 runs, every run returned, the counter step a permutation for all 17 lengths), conserves energy and charge, keeps the old knit bit for bit on 288 vacuum and gas beats, runs a full torus as the old knit at 1/17 on 204 beats, commutes with charge conjugation and the 2 e4 shift, and takes on exactly L(E) on 472,897 of 472,897 intervals; but the two natural designs are not bijections (take-or-keep loses a vibe, the carry gate read at the take maps two states to one), a counter-only gate slows nothing on average over counter starts (exactly 1 of 17 values at 0 on every beat, for every L), a filled-slot gate cannot spare the vacuum (a hub dock holds 24 of 24 slots on 12,288 of 159,744 dock-beats), and a crowd started at rest melts, taking on 25,345 of 31,680 crowd dock-beats.
known_limitations: Depth L2 (L2: known physics reproduced on a stated model).
